multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: Current evidence and affectedSurfaces define actual scope.

evidenceIndex.claim: Product Truth and canonical governance outrank derived support.
evidenceIndex.result: This package cannot expand field scope or create policy.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current branch was re-resolved during diagnosis.
evidenceIndex.result: Package is pinned after concurrent movement reconciliation.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Executor must re-resolve again before implementation/final push.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current field composition has explicit readiness failure handling.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static source is not device/server proof.

evidenceIndex.claim: Canonical test command targets src/__tests__, but current src tree has no __tests__ or test files.
evidenceIndex.result: Field behavioral test gate is a confirmed blocker.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Other tests do not repair the canonical gate.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current field replay covers four governed operations through one offline sync path.
evidenceIndex.result: Replay breadth exists and must be preserved.

evidenceIndex.claim: V2 queue scopes actor/installation, carries idempotency/correlation, quarantines corrupt data and retries with backoff; preparation removes legacy v1 key.
evidenceIndex.result: Core queue exists; lossless legacy migration and ambiguous-result safety require proof.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static inspection cannot prove real recovery.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current queue distinguishes current and stale/revoked work.
evidenceIndex.result: Old flat/open-only queue finding is stale.

evidenceIndex.claim: DSH governs field visit/checklist mutations with worker/store authorization and completion prerequisites.
Current field-finance API/controller/payout-attempt logic exists, including prepared/unknown attempt persistence.

evidenceIndex.result: Retained as provenance, not current closure.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Historical implementation SHAs can still guide targeted verification.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field onboarding has bounded operator/partner/client readback and excludes Captain custody.
Field activation/session trust is Identity-owned and Workforce-governed.
evidenceIndex.result: Identity/Workforce are field trust dependencies only.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field representative finance preserves WLT ownership.
evidenceIndex.result: WLT scope is bounded to field finance truth/readback.

evidenceIndex.claim: app-field is excluded from store-to-captain custody after readiness.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain/COD/handoff implementation is out of scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Reopen only if authoritative Product Truth changes.
